headers.comment: Content-hashed by Vite, so the name changes whenever the bytes do.
The daily puzzle flips at each player's local midnight; a cached copy would serve yesterday's five. Revalidation is a 304, so this is cheap.
Served under fixed names, so they cannot be immutable — a new model would never reach anyone holding the old one.
The entry point names the current chunk hashes. Stale HTML is what leaves a tab asking for a chunk that no longer exists.
